option_relations.rationale: SARS-CoV-2–associated optic neuritis is a specific instance of COVID-19-associated optic neuritis
COVID-19-associated optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis is a broader class containing COVID-19-associated optic neuritis
Immune-mediated parainfectious optic neuritis is not directly related to COVID-19-associated optic neuritis
Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis is not directly related to COVID-19-associated optic neuritis
